name: Storyrus (FortesHub)
start: cd backend && . .venv/bin/activate && python -m alembic upgrade head && python scripts/seed.py

terminals.name: api
terminals.command: cd backend && . .venv/bin/activate && exec python -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000

terminals.name: web
terminals.command: cd apps/web && exec npm run dev
